reply_text:
I replied to Marcus in a thread on their message in #north-team: the contact for the door 6 duplicate arrivals at Quarrendon Freight Lines is **Thea Ramaswell**. She's QFL's Director of Yard Operations and their main contact.

The source is a #north-team post from Dana on 20 Aug 2025, and Marcus is in that channel. Dana wrote that Thea had flagged the door 6 duplicates again on the morning shift. The problem was the same trailer showing up as two 06:30 check-ins, one from the kiosk and one added by dispatch. Dana owns the account and said they were looking into it. I found nothing newer on whether it was fixed, and I didn't say anything either way.

The brain also has a note about two appointments stacked on door 6, but that's Brackenwater Freight Co., a different account, so I left it out.
